_README: TEMPLATE. Copy to pricing.json (gitignored) and replace every number with prices you have just checked. The values below were accurate on the `retrieved` date and are almost certainly wrong now. estimate.py warns if `retrieved` is over 90 days old, and runs without any pricing.json at all -- it just reports token and call counts instead of dollars.
note: Prices change without notice. Re-check against vendor pricing pages and update `retrieved` before trusting any projection. Every sweep records this date in data/run_manifest.jsonl.

token_prices._comment: Per 1M tokens, keyed by provider model_id. Models absent here cost 0 in estimates -- add yours before running estimate.py.

search_fees._comment: Per-call fee for the web-search/grounding tool, charged on top of tokens. `free_per_month` is a batch-level allowance applied by estimate.py, not per call.

openai.note: web_search built-in tool, $10.00 / 1k calls. Retrieved content is ALSO billed as input tokens at full model rates, which usually dominates.

gemini.note: Grounding with Google Search, $14 / 1k queries after 5,000/month free (shared across the Gemini 3 family).

perplexity.note: Sonar reports its own total in usage.cost, including the per-request search fee, so it is read back rather than recomputed.
